t: Resolved. That the name of that portion of Rockdale drive between Lulu alley and San Martin way, be and is hereby changed to Burlwood drive…
pl: Rockdale Drive renamed Burlwood Drive and San Martin Way renamed Rockdale

t: The name of Rockdale drive, between Los Palmos drive and Lulu alley, be and is hereby changed to Burlwood drive.
pl: Rockdale Drive renamed Burlwood Drive between Los Palmos and Lulu
